title: The questions that get past "everything is fine"

videos.script: Renata asks Thiago how on-call is going. He says it is fine. {{title}} Two months later she learns the rest. He sleeps badly before every on-call week. He was paged at three in the morning for an alert nobody had explained. {{rest}} He did not lie. On-call was working. The cost of it was the part nobody asked about. {{cost}} This lesson is about why fine is a reasonable answer to a vague question. And why the person is talking to somebody who writes their review. {{power}} Then the questions that have edges. A week, a moment, a number with a follow-up. {{edges}} And what to do in the five seconds after the first answer. Because the useful part usually comes second. {{listen}}
